subject: website
name: Madhav Goyal
summary: Madhav Goyal's blog of dated posts, static HTML pages served as written, so its source is public (no licence file); its MathJax 3.2.0 file is byte-identical to the official build. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: many posts load images from storage.googleapis.com and Substack's image CDN when they are read.

connections.name: Images in posts (storage.googleapis.com, substackcdn.com)
connections.note: Fetched when a post that uses them is opened.
